Title: CataTweaks
Author: alex
Description: QoL tweaks: habs named 'Name (Template, Orbit, Body)' on template apply, with save-as-template round-tripping the template name and map icon and overwriting in place; priority presets overwrite and track too; dividing rules between stations on the ship construction screen. Balance: solar mirrors boost orbital stations inward of them, and Review Failed Projects favours the expensive missed project instead of the cheapest. (Code mod; requires Unity Mod Manager. Toggle applies on restart.)
